module.Title: Run an Equipment Sequence
module.Teaching: A sequence combines ordered steps with safety checks. Each step should happen only after required conditions pass.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why are all three startup lines indented?
PredictionOptions: They belong to the safe branch
module.PredictionExplanation: Indentation groups the ordered startup actions under the safety condition.
module.DebugPrompt: Indent the branch bodies so Python can identify each block.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the ventilation startup sequence. Use these exact identifiers: print, safety_ok. Use these exact values: "Open damper", "Sequence blocked", "Start exhaust fan", "Start process equipment".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a shutdown sequence that stops equipment, closes a valve, then stops the fan. Use these exact identifiers: print, shutdown_command. Use these exact values: "Close valve", "Stop exhaust fan", "Stop process equipment".
module.TransferCode:
if shutdown_command:
    print("Stop process equipment")
    print("Close valve")
    print("Stop exhaust fan")
module.PreviewMessage: The simulator now performs ordered equipment actions.
